title: Read the legacy timeline planner context
summary: Assemble the immutable native timeline-ops Skill into planner context, including static and dynamic chunks, selected Skills, combo ids and primitive dependencies. It never executes those primitives.

carrier.notes: Reached through luc_invoke after discovery and description. Schemas describe the result before the wrapper; Runtime context and authority are supplied separately by the Host.

replaceability.why: The Luc references an immutable native prompt and the in-process gemia planner assembler. A creator's layer on the Official package may add a sandboxed program (luc_tool_program) that answers for the capability while keeping its pinned native_skill, instruction hash and schema.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, 2026-10-24; sandboxed program replacement wired via luc_tool_program (lumeri_runtime/native_skill_panel.py:99-197, lumeri_runtime/luc_interface_gate.py:35-44)

operations.name: assemble_native_planner_context
operations.notes: No timeout is enforced on this in-process assembly. Repeating a read reassembles the same pinned Skill against the same request/context; it checks that the source text still equals the bound instruction. Optional effective_request, has_video_context and budget default to empty, false and 5000. This legacy capability is reached through luc_invoke, not the v2 use_skill path.

bounds.name: agent_result_chars
bounds.unit: characters before the model result is clipped; the cut notice is appended

bounds.name: budget
bounds.unit: planner budget units, minimum one; default 5000

invariants.text: The result preserves every native planner chunk and dependency identity, without executing a Project edit.

break: A replacement program exits, exceeds its deadline or returns an invalid result/refusal.
The trusted binding is absent, changed or refuses the invocation.
An input, result or Host context fails validation.
failure.notes: When a layer's program breaks, the adapter records the break in LucBreaker and falls back to the Official native-skill-prompt implementation for the rest of the start.

conformance.notes: Verified across Official adapter tests and sandboxed program on/off/break replacement tests.
